headline: COL @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 5.50 at OAK 5.93, with a projected total of 11.42. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: COL moved +0.59 runs while OAK moved +0.89, changing the projected margin by -0.30 runs. The projected total climbed +1.48, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Jake McCarthy, Troy Johnston, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
